title: Ashbury Rewards Member Benefit Terms: The Elite Breakfast Benefit on Guest Folios
content:
## Terms in force

1. **Entitlement.** At Ashbury brands that do not include breakfast for every guest, a stay credited to an Ashbury Rewards member whose tier is the brand's lowest tier entitled to the elite breakfast benefit, or higher, receives a credit on the Guest Folio for each breakfast line charged at the outlet during the stay.
2. **One credit per breakfast line.** The credit names the breakfast line it offsets, and there is at most one credit per breakfast line.
3. **The tier that counts.** The member's tier is the tier shown on the membership, and it applies to a breakfast only when the membership's tier effective date is on or before that breakfast's business date. When the tier took effect after the breakfast, guest services cannot establish the tier held that morning and refers the question to the hotel as a billing dispute.
4. **Stays without the credit.** No credit is given on Bed & Breakfast Package Rate stays, where breakfast is part of the rate, or on reservations booked through an online travel agency.
5. **Status of the folio.** Credits are posted only to a folio whose status is open or reopened.

The brand figures this benefit reads — whether breakfast is included for all guests, the lowest entitled tier, the brand's credit per person and the brand's persons covered — are those of the brand's breakfast entitlement grid.

## Terms no longer in force

The following former terms are **no longer in force** and are superseded by the current basis:

- the former term that set the credit as the lower of the breakfast line's amount and the brand's credit per person times the brand's persons covered;
- the former term under which, when the outlet did not apply the credit, guest services posted it later with the reason that the elite benefit was not applied, subject to the brand's desk adjustment limit;
- the former term under which unused credit was not paid out or carried to other charges where the brand's setting so provided.

## The tier date test

The test is made on the system record of the membership credited for the stay, matched to the folio through that membership, and compared with each breakfast's business date. Equality satisfies it.

| Hypothetical case | Breakfast business date | Tier effective date | Tier applies to that breakfast |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tier reached weeks before the stay | 14 June | 2 May | Yes |
| Tier reached on the morning of the breakfast | 14 June | 14 June | Yes |
| Tier reached the day after the breakfast | 14 June | 15 June | No: the tier held that morning cannot be established, and the question is referred to the hotel as a billing dispute |

## Points of judgement

- **Bed & Breakfast Package Rate.** Breakfast is part of the rate; no credit.
- **Booked through an online travel agency.** No credit.
- **A breakfast line that already carries a credit.** A second credit is not given on it.
- **A settled folio.** Credits are posted only to an open or reopened folio.

superseded_clauses: a credit of the lower of that line's amount and elite_breakfast_credit_per_person_usd times elite_breakfast_persons.
When the outlet did not apply the credit, guest services posts it later with adjustment_reason elite_benefit_not_applied, subject to the brand's desk_adjustment_limit_usd.
unused credit is not paid out or carried to other charges when breakfast_credit_unused_refundable is false.
